name: Deterministic Edge-Level Input Sanitization and Real-Time UX Friction Reduction
principle: Perform deterministic, client-side recursive sanitization (regex masking, WeakSet cycle detection, Base64 sniffing, CSV formula escaping, and prototype pollution protection) at the immediate input boundary combined with explicit accessible UI feedback (live character count, preview tables, status regions, syntax alerts) to eliminate confidential credential/PII leaks and minimize operator task friction.

supporting_evidence.domain: Deeply Nested Configuration & Raw Payload Importer
Tabular CSV & Column-Level Batch Dataset Uploader

valid_scope: Diagnostic and error feedback log submission modals
Customer support ticket dispatching with environment metadata and PII
Nested JSON/YAML-like configuration and batch metadata import interfaces
Tabular CSV / TSV batch dataset uploaders with column-level PII & formula injection defense
Edge-level regex, WeakSet cycle detection, and recursive credential masking
Lightweight accessible UI feedback (live character count, preview grids, status regions)
probable_scope: Form workflows in adjacent web applications with similar text/JSON structures
Client-side Excel/XML export transformers with PII masking
Admin dashboard settings and API integration management forms
unknown_scope: Rich-text WYSIWYG editors with embedded markup ASTs
Financial transaction clearing and high-frequency trading inputs
excluded_scope: High-concurrency streaming binary protocols (WebSockets / gRPC streams) [DO_NOT_TRANSFER]
Server-side database storage encryption and backend authorization barriers
Core Control Plane internal state machine governance
